definitions.explanation: The act of writing books or scholarly works, or the written work itself. Formal; primarily used for books, academic writing, and the profession of writing.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{著述|ちょじゅつ}を{仕事|しごと}にしている。
examples.english: My father makes a living by writing.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{著述|ちょじゅつ}は{広|ひろ}く{読|よ}まれている。
{長年|ながねん}の{研究|けんきゅう}を{元|もと}に、{著述|ちょじゅつ}{活動|かつどう}を{本格的|ほんかくてき}に{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Drawing on many years of research, he began writing in earnest.

notes:
Compound of {著|ちょ} (to write, to publish) + {述|じゅつ} (to state). Used as a する verb in {著述|ちょじゅつ}する (to write [a work]).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}{業|ぎょう}: the writing profession; author by trade
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}{家|か}: author; writer (of books)
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}{活動|かつどう}: writing activity
- {著述|ちょじゅつ}を{重|かさ}ねる: build up a body of writing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {執筆|しっぴつ}: writing (the act) — focuses on the act of writing, often for a specific piece
- {著作|ちょさく}: written work — emphasizes the work as a product; basis of {著作権|ちょさくけん} (copyright)
- {作品|さくひん}: work — general term for any creative work, not specific to writing
